module.title: International Health Data Platform, Interoperability and Longitudinal Record
module.business_purpose: Provides a governed international-grade health data center: source onboarding, ingestion, canonical versioned resources, patient identity resolution, FHIR validation, quality, provenance, lineage, terminology mapping, controlled exports, de-identification and OMOP transformation.
